{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat >> specs/001-transactions/research.md <<'EOF'

## Open Gaps (convergence, 2026-10-16)

- **R5 refinement (partial gap, FR-006/SC-002)**: pytest.ini `addopts` include
  `--cov-append --cov-report term --cov tinydb`, which require pytest-cov. pytest-cov
  is not installed in this environment, so the bare existing invocation
  `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest` exits 4 with `unrecognized arguments: --cov-*`
  before collection (pre-existing repo condition; affects the whole suite, not
  smoke-specific). Verified workaround (no repo files modified): target suite
  `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -o addopts="" tests/test_smoke.py` -> 9 passed,
  exit 0; full suite `PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -o addopts=""` -> 232 passed,
  exit 0. Fixing would mean installing pytest-cov (new dependency, out of scope per
  SC-004) or editing pytest.ini (out of scope); documented per Constitution V.
EOF
echo '=== research.md tail ===' && tail -14 specs/001-transactions/research.md"}
